newsitem.title: NORWAY: Licensees opt for larger gas line at Aasgard field.
newsitem.headline: Licensees opt for larger gas line at Aasgard field.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday partners in the Aasgard development off mid-Norway had decided on a 42-inch diameter for the gas pipeline to the Kaarstoe terminal.
The dimension was left open when the group submitted plans for installation and operation to the Energy Ministry at the end of last year.
Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said the licensees had recommeded to the ministry 42 inches rather than 40 inches to open the possibility of carrying gas from other nearby fields.
Norway's Gas Supply Committee is expected to make a recommendation on the pipeline's size soon, Statoil said.
Licensees in the Aasgard group are Statoil, Agip SpA, Total SA, Mobil Corp, Neste Oy, Saga Petroleum ASA and Norsk Hydro ASA.
